evidence: Numerical, input-provenance and repository checks for the local follow-up. Human comfort and scene appearance require separate physical and empirical validation.

remote_baseline.access: Tracked products and packed sky data. Raw local archives, simulations and several spectral inputs were outside that execution environment.

local_input_setup.storage: Research-drive optical-comfort-runs for copied inputs, caches, Python environment and generated products; existing CM1/GCM/wave runs linked from that drive.
local_input_setup.other_checkouts: Source checkout read for input copies; branch edits and generated reports confined to study/optical-comfort.

skipped.explanation: These optional inputs were outside the local optical setup; their dependent tests report explicit skips.

numerical.native_sky: 630 gaze cases and 24 finite scenes; fixed baseline Sobol seeds and geometry; angular and sample-refinement diagnostics retained.
numerical.cloud: 236 saved second-cycle snapshots, 23,810 dusk columns; CM1 source hashes, raw snapshot hashes, dry-density comparison and species mass closure.
numerical.water: 709 hourly spectra at four stations, second cycle only; output hashes, dispersion residual, frequency-refinement diagnostics and finite-band slope covariance.

scientific_review.method_reading: Focused primary-source equations and SWAN format definitions; CM1 source conventions inspected locally.
